'''Powerbus cables''' were components used in [[Droid/Legends|droids]],<ref name="SW:TVD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> such as [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica's]] [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]] and [[M-3PO military protocol droid]]. The cables were most visible around the droid's torso area.<ref name="EGTD" />
